statement: ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (∑' i : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ((ε : ℝ) / 4 / 2 ^ i))) = (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
intro ε
have heq (i : ℕ) : 2 * ((ε : ℝ) / 4 / 2 ^ i) = (ε : ℝ) / 2 / 2 ^ i := by ring
simp_rw [heq]
rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun i => by positivity) (summable_geometric_two' (ε : ℝ)), tsum_geometric_two']
simp
